title: Combined Graduate Level Examination 2026

fees.paymentMode: Online (Net Banking / Debit / Credit Card / UPI)

ageLimit.relaxation: OBC +3 years, SC/ST +5 years, PwBD +10 years, as per Govt norms

eligibility: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University
Candidates in the final year of graduation may also apply provisionally
Specific posts require additional qualifications — check official notification
howToApply: Visit the official SSC website and register using a valid email ID and mobile number
Fill in personal, educational and category details carefully
Upload scanned photograph and signature as per specifications
Pay the application fee online (if applicable)
Submit the form and save/print the confirmation page for future reference
description: The Staff Selection Commission has released the notification for Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Examination 2026 to fill various Group B and Group C posts in different Ministries, Departments and Organisations of the Government of India. This is one of the most awaited recruitment drives of the year, offering opportunities across multiple central government departments.
examPattern: Objective type, computer-based test covering General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, English Comprehension and General Awareness

title: Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC) Recruitment 2026

fees.paymentMode: Online only; fee partially refundable on appearing for exam

ageLimit.relaxation: OBC +3 years, SC/ST +5 years, as per RRB norms

eligibility: Graduate / Undergraduate depending on the post applied for
Candidates must meet post-specific educational qualifications listed in the official notification
howToApply: Register on the official RRB website with basic details
Login and complete the application form with education and address details
Upload photograph and signature in prescribed format
Pay the requisite fee through available online modes
Submit and download the confirmation slip
description: Railway Recruitment Boards across India have jointly announced vacancies under the Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC) for various posts including Station Master, Goods Guard and Commercial Apprentice. This is one of the largest recruitment drives conducted by Indian Railways, attracting lakhs of applicants every cycle.
examPattern: Computer Based Test with sections on Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness

title: Probationary Officer (PO) Recruitment 2026

ageLimit.relaxation: As per Government of India / SBI norms for reserved categories

eligibility: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university
Final year students awaiting results may apply provisionally
howToApply: Go to the official SBI careers portal and click on the PO recruitment link
Fill the online application form with personal and academic details
Upload photograph, signature and other documents as specified
Pay the application fee online
Submit the application and retain the printout for future correspondence
description: State Bank of India has invited online applications from eligible candidates for recruitment to the post of Probationary Officer (PO). Selected candidates will undergo training and be posted across various branches of the bank throughout the country.
examPattern: Objective test for Prelims; Objective + Descriptive for Mains; Group Discussion and Interview for final selection

title: Civil Services Examination (CSE) 2026

ageLimit.relaxation: OBC +3 years, SC/ST +5 years, as per UPSC norms

eligibility: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university in any discipline
Candidates appearing in the final year exam are also eligible to apply
howToApply: Register on the official UPSC online application portal (OTR)
Complete Part I and Part II of the application form
Upload photograph and signature as per guidelines
Pay the examination fee where applicable
Print the application summary for records
description: The Union Public Service Commission has announced the Civil Services Examination 2026 for recruitment to prestigious All India Services including IAS, IPS and IFS along with various Central Group A and Group B services. The exam is conducted in three stages: Preliminary, Main and Interview.
examPattern: Objective type for Prelims (General Studies + CSAT); Descriptive/Written for Mains across 9 papers

title: Police Constable Recruitment 2026

ageLimit.relaxation: As per State Government reservation policy

eligibility: Higher Secondary (12th) pass from a recognised board
Candidates must meet the prescribed physical standards (height, chest, endurance test)
howToApply: Visit the State Police recruitment portal and create a login
Fill in personal, physical and educational details
Upload photograph, signature and category certificates
Pay the applicable fee online
Submit the form and download the acknowledgement
description: The State Police Department has announced a large-scale recruitment drive for the post of Police Constable across various districts. The selection process includes a written examination, physical efficiency test and medical examination.
examPattern: Objective type written test covering General Knowledge, Reasoning, Arithmetic and Marathi/English Language

title: Trade & Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026

ageLimit.relaxation: OBC +3 years, SC/ST +5 years, PwBD +10 years

eligibility: ITI in relevant trade / Diploma / Graduate depending on the apprenticeship category
Candidates should not have undergone apprenticeship training earlier under the Apprentices Act
howToApply: Register on the Apprenticeship India portal (NATS/NAPS)
Link your profile with the IOCL apprentice notification
Fill in trade preference, qualification and personal details
Upload required documents and certificates
Submit the application before the last date
description: Indian Oil Corporation Limited invites applications from eligible candidates for engagement as Trade Apprentices and Technician Apprentices at various plants, terminals and offices under the Apprentices Act, 1961. No application fee is charged for this recruitment.
selectionProcess: Merit List based on Qualifying Exam Marks
examPattern: No written exam; selection primarily on merit of qualifying examination marks

title: Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) & Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) Recruitment 2026

ageLimit.relaxation: As per State Government norms for reserved categories

eligibility: Postgraduate degree in relevant subject with B.Ed for PGT posts
Graduate degree in relevant subject with B.Ed for TGT posts
Must qualify the applicable Teacher Eligibility Test (TET)
howToApply: Visit the State Education Department recruitment portal
Register and fill in academic, professional and personal details
Upload scanned copies of certificates, photograph and signature
Pay the examination fee as applicable
Submit the form and save the confirmation receipt
description: The State Education Department has released vacancies for Post Graduate Teachers and Trained Graduate Teachers across government schools. This recruitment aims to fill long-pending teaching vacancies in various subjects at the secondary and higher secondary level.
examPattern: Objective type test covering subject knowledge, pedagogy and general awareness

title: Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026
department: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)

ageLimit.relaxation: OBC +3 years, SC/ST +5 years, as per AIIMS norms

eligibility: B.Sc (Hons) Nursing / B.Sc Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc Nursing from a recognised institute
Registration with State Nursing Council or Indian Nursing Council is mandatory
howToApply: Visit the AIIMS recruitment portal and register with valid credentials
Complete the application form with educational and professional details
Upload photograph, signature and nursing council registration certificate
Pay the application fee online
Submit and print the application form for future reference
description: AIIMS New Delhi has announced recruitment for the post of Nursing Officer across its various centres. This is a golden opportunity for qualified nursing professionals to join one of the premier medical institutes of the country.
examPattern: Objective type test covering Nursing subjects, General Knowledge and Reasoning
